summaries.en: Track Claude Code and Codex (CLI + app) sessions and task progress in the notch.
summaries.zh-Hans: 在刘海里盯住 Claude Code 与 Codex（CLI + 桌面 App）的并行会话与任务进度。

descriptions.en:
Keep every parallel AI coding session in view from the notch tray — **Claude Code** and **Codex (CLI and desktop app)** side by side.

**The list**

- Grouped by project (the git repo root found by walking up from the session cwd), collapsible and scrollable, with an `active/total` badge and a summary dot when collapsed
- Each row: agent logo, status dot, task prompt, current step, progress, elapsed time
- Claude Code rows show a `done/total` step bar (from TodoWrite / TaskCreate)
- Codex rows carry an `App` / `CLI` / `Exec` origin tag; it has no todo list, so a live turn shows `▸commands Δfiles-changed ⑂subagents` plus the running command
- Finished, ended and stalled rows can be dismissed one by one or all at once

**Notifications**

One ongoing notification per live session (it switches to paused while the agent waits for approval), plus an unread event when a task finishes — progress and results are readable straight from the notch.

**Click a row to jump back to the session**

- Codex desktop app: the official `codex://threads/<id>` deep link
- Codex CLI / exec: finds the process holding the session file, then its tty and hosting app
- Terminal / iTerm2: AppleScript selects the exact tab by tty
- Warp: official session deep link first, falling back to an OSC2 title marker plus tab cycling (needs Accessibility permission)
- VS Code / Cursor: focuses the window that has the folder open

**Setup**

- Claude Code: press "Install hooks" to write them into `~/.claude/settings.json` (backed up first); they take effect immediately
- Codex: **nothing to install**. The CLI and the desktop app share the session logs under `~/.codex/sessions`, and this widget only reads them — no hook, no `config.toml` edit, nothing written into `~/.codex`

**Privacy**: all state is read and written locally; nothing leaves the machine.
descriptions.zh-Hans:
在刘海托盘里盯住所有并行的 AI 编码会话——**Claude Code** 与 **Codex（CLI 与桌面 App）**同屏。

**列表**

- 按项目分组（从会话 cwd 向上找 git 仓库根），可折叠、可滚动，折叠后显示 `活跃/总数` 与状态汇总点
- 每行：agent logo + 状态点 + 任务 prompt + 当前步骤 + 进度 + 已运行时长
- Claude Code 显示 `已完成/总步骤` 进度条（来自 TodoWrite / TaskCreate）
- Codex 显示 `App` / `CLI` / `Exec` 来源标签；它没有 todo 列表，进行中改用 `▸命令数 Δ改文件数 ⑂子代理数` 与当前命令
- 完成/结束/无响应的行可逐条 ✕ 或一键清理

**通知**

每个活跃会话一条持续通知（等待授权自动变暂停态），任务完成发一条未读事件——刘海延伸区直接能看到进度和结果。

**点击跳回会话**

- Codex 桌面 App：走官方深链 `codex://threads/<id>`，直达该会话
- Codex CLI / exec：定位持有会话文件的进程，找到它的 tty 与承载 App
- Terminal / iTerm2：AppleScript 按 tty 精确选中标签页
- Warp：优先官方 session 深链，回落 OSC2 标题标记 + 循环切换（需辅助功能授权）
- VS Code / Cursor：聚焦打开着该目录的窗口

**接入方式**

- Claude Code：点「一键接入」，把 hook 写进 `~/.claude/settings.json`（首次写入前自动备份），当场生效
- Codex：**不用装任何东西**。CLI 与桌面 App 共用 `~/.codex/sessions` 下的会话日志，组件只读它——不装 hook、不改 `config.toml`、不往 `~/.codex` 写任何东西

**隐私**：所有状态只在本机读写，无任何数据出网。

summaries.en: Apple Music in the notch: artwork tint, embedded lyrics, seek and volume.
summaries.zh-Hans: 刘海里的 Apple Music 控制盘：封面取色、内嵌歌词滚动、进度与音量。

descriptions.en:
An Apple Music control panel in the notch — artwork, lyrics, seek and volume in one card, without switching back to Music.app.

**The card**

- The album artwork's dominant color tints the card background, and follows every track change
- Title / artist / album on three lines, with long titles truncated
- Embedded lyrics scroll line by line with the current line highlighted; with no lyrics it switches to a large-artwork layout instead of leaving a blank gap

**Controls**

- Previous / play-pause / next, with the tray chip icon switching between ▶︎ and ⏸ to match the player state
- Draggable seek bar, and a volume slider wired to Music's application volume
- "Previous" resets the play position to zero first — Music otherwise follows the "restart the current track if more than ~2s in" convention, so without it the button never actually changes track

**Notifications**

While playing, an ongoing notification (title + artist) sits in the notch extension area; it flips to paused when you pause and ends when playback stops.

**Performance**

The script only runs on track change, play-state change and a 5s fallback sync; progress and the active lyric line advance locally against the wall clock instead of calling AppleScript once a second.

**Requirements**

- Apple Music only (the built-in macOS Music.app) — Spotify and other third-party players are not supported
- Needs Automation access on first use: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation › NotchAny › enable "Music". Without it the widget shows guidance rather than an error
- When Music.app isn't running it offers an "Open Music" button instead of launching it behind your back

**About lyrics**: only lyrics embedded in the audio file are read, with **no network access at all**. Apple Music streaming tracks almost never carry embedded lyrics, so the large-artwork layout is what you'll normally see; imported local files are the ones that may have line-by-line lyrics.

**Privacy**: no network requests whatsoever — everything comes from the local Music.app and nothing leaves the machine.
descriptions.zh-Hans:
刘海里的 Apple Music 控制盘：封面、歌词、进度、音量一屏搞定，不用切回 Music.app。

**卡片**

- 专辑封面取主色渲染卡片底色，换曲自动跟着换
- 曲名 / 艺人 / 专辑三行元信息，长曲名自动截断
- 有内嵌歌词时逐行滚动、当前行高亮；没有歌词自动切到「大封面」版式，不留空白

**控制**

- 上一曲 / 播放暂停 / 下一曲，托盘芯片图标跟着播放态在 ▶︎ 与 ⏸ 之间切换
- 进度条可拖动跳转，音量条直接改 Music 的应用音量
- 「上一曲」会先把播放位置归零再切——Music 默认「播放超过 2 秒就重播当前曲」，不这么做按了不换曲

**通知**

正在播放时在刘海延伸区挂一条持续通知（曲名 + 艺人），暂停转为暂停态，停止播放即结束。

**性能**

脚本只在换曲、播放态变化和 5 秒兜底时跑；进度与歌词行由组件按墙钟本地推进，不是每秒调一次 AppleScript。

**前置条件**

- 只支持 Apple Music（macOS 自带 Music.app），不支持 Spotify 等第三方播放器
- 首次使用需要授权自动化：系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 自动化 › NotchAny › 勾选「音乐」。未授权时组件会显示引导而不是报错
- Music.app 没运行时显示「打开 Music」按钮，不会自作主张启动它

**歌词说明**：只读音频文件里的内嵌歌词，**完全不联网**。Apple Music 的流媒体曲目基本读不到内嵌歌词，所以平时走的是大封面版式；自己导入的本地文件才可能有逐行歌词。

**隐私**：无任何网络请求，全部数据来自本机 Music.app，不出网。

summaries.zh-Hans: 实时显示 CPU 占用率的托盘小组件，视觉与内置 CPU 件一致，可自由改造。
summaries.en: Tray widget showing live CPU usage, visually matching the built-in CPU widget.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
指标风格的 CPU 占用小组件：

- 数据源为全进程 `%cpu` 求和 / 核数的近似值（`ps` + `awk`，零依赖）
- 可见时每秒刷新，收起自动停表
- 带趋势条与阈值配色（≥75% 变黄、≥90% 变红）
- 响应式布局（container query）：1×1 到 1×8 均可摆放

源码与内置 CPU 件同款，导入后可在设置 > 小组件里随意改造脚本与样式。
descriptions.en:
Metric-style CPU usage widget:

- Data source approximates usage as the sum of per-process `%cpu` divided by core count (`ps` + `awk`, zero dependencies)
- Refreshes every second while visible, pauses when hidden
- Trend bars with threshold colors (yellow at 75%, red at 90%)
- Responsive layout (container queries) from 1x1 up to 1x8

Same source as the built-in CPU widget; tweak the script and styles freely after importing.

summaries.zh-Hans: 显示系统盘已用百分比的托盘小组件，5 秒一刷，同内置系统盘件。
summaries.en: Tray widget showing system disk usage percentage, refreshed every 5 seconds.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
指标风格的系统盘占用小组件：

- 数据源用 `df -k /` 取根分区已用百分比（零依赖）
- 磁盘变化慢，可见时 5 秒一刷即可，收起自动停表
- 阈值配色与内置件一致（≥75% 变黄、≥90% 变红）

源码与内置系统盘件同款，把脚本里的挂载点换掉即可监控其它磁盘。
descriptions.en:
Metric-style system disk usage widget:

- Data source reads the root partition usage percentage via `df -k /` (zero dependencies)
- Disks change slowly, so it refreshes every 5 seconds while visible and pauses when hidden
- Same threshold colors as the built-in widget (yellow at 75%, red at 90%)

Same source as the built-in disk widget; change the mount point in the script to watch another disk.

summaries.zh-Hans: 把拖进刘海的图片批量转成 JPEG，用 macOS 自带 sips，零第三方依赖。
summaries.en: Convert images dropped on the notch to JPEG with the built-in sips tool.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
带文件输入的 shell 动作示例：

- `input_kind` 为 filesOnly——把图片拖到刘海投放到本动作即可
- 用 macOS 自带的 `sips` 转为 JPEG，写入 NotchAny 解析的输出目录（`$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR`），重名自动加序号
- 产物经 `notch_result --output` 逐个上报，完成后可直接在反馈里拖走
- 支持多文件批量转换

配合拖放规则（match: kinds=image）可以做到「拖图片进刘海自动转 JPG」。
descriptions.en:
A shell action example with file input:

- `input_kind` is filesOnly: drop images onto the notch and route them to this action
- Converts to JPEG with the built-in `sips`, writing into the output directory resolved by NotchAny (`$NOTCH_OUTPUT_DIR`) and auto-suffixing on name clashes
- Each product is reported via `notch_result --output`, ready to drag away from the feedback
- Handles multiple files in one drop

Pair it with a drop rule (match: kinds=image) to convert any dropped image automatically.

summaries.zh-Hans: 实时显示内存占用的托盘小组件（active + wired + compressor），同内置内存件。
summaries.en: Tray widget showing live memory usage (active + wired + compressor pages).

descriptions.zh-Hans:
指标风格的内存占用小组件：

- 数据源用 `vm_stat` 统计 active + wired + compressor 页数 × 页大小，除以物理内存
- 详情行显示「已用 / 总量 GB」
- 可见时每秒刷新，收起自动停表；阈值配色与内置件一致

源码与内置内存件同款，导入后可自由改造。
descriptions.en:
Metric-style memory usage widget:

- Data source sums active + wired + compressor pages from `vm_stat`, multiplied by page size, divided by physical memory
- Detail line shows used / total in GB
- Refreshes every second while visible, pauses when hidden; same threshold colors as the built-in widget

Same source as the built-in memory widget; customize freely after importing.

summaries.zh-Hans: 指标风格小组件起手模板：换掉数据脚本即可做出自己的百分比指标件。
summaries.en: Starter template for metric widgets: swap the data script to build your own.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
做自己的指标小组件的起手模板，视觉对齐内置 CPU/内存/系统盘件：

- HTML/CSS/JS 即官方指标模板（趋势条、阈值配色、container query 响应式）
- 数据脚本是占位示例，把它换成你的采集逻辑，经 `notch_result --widget-json` 回传 `{"fraction": 0.42, "detail": "说明文字", "name": "可选标题", "trend": [0.1, 0.5]}` 即可
- `fraction`（0–1）驱动百分比与进度条；`trend` 数组驱动趋势条；都可省略
descriptions.en:
Starter template for building your own metric widget, visually aligned with the built-in CPU/memory/disk widgets:

- HTML/CSS/JS is the official metric template (trend bars, threshold colors, responsive container queries)
- The data script is a placeholder: replace it with your own collector and report `{"fraction": 0.42, "detail": "caption", "name": "optional title", "trend": [0.1, 0.5]}` via `notch_result --widget-json`
- `fraction` (0-1) drives the percentage and progress bar; the `trend` array drives the trend bars; both are optional

summaries.zh-Hans: 一键查看当前连接的 Wi-Fi 网络名称，简单 shell 动作示例。
summaries.en: Show the name of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to, in one click.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
最小可用的 shell 动作示例：

- 点击后用 macOS 自带的 `networksetup -getairportnetwork en0` 查询当前 Wi-Fi
- 结果经 `notch_result --summary` 显示在刘海反馈里，详情里保留原始输出
- 未连接时显示「未连接 Wi-Fi」

也适合当作学习动作脚本契约（环境变量 + `notch_result`）的起点。
descriptions.en:
A minimal shell action example:

- On click, queries the current Wi-Fi via the built-in `networksetup -getairportnetwork en0`
- Reports the result through `notch_result --summary`, keeping the raw output in the details
- Shows a "not connected" summary when there is no Wi-Fi

Also a good starting point for learning the action script contract (environment variables + `notch_result`).
